verdict.rationale: Salv documents a substantive public API (OAuth2, an OpenAPI spec, a sandbox): person and transaction ingestion, real-time monitoring checks, alert status updates, manual alerts, risk factors, on-demand screening and webhooks. However, the docs themselves say only "some of the configuration" (Custom Lists) is available via API, and API token invalidation is done in the UI. That means UI-API parity is explicitly not claimed. Missing for 10: API coverage of scenario/rule configuration, backtesting/flow drafting, case management, clearance rules and good-listing, credential management via API, and any stated commitment to full UI parity.
